settings.faviconTooLarge: The file is too large (max. 256 KB).
settings.faviconInvalidType: Only PNG, ICO or SVG are allowed.
settings.downloadBackup: Download backup (JSON, all data and files)
settings.restoreHint: Replaces ALL current data — every table and the files — with the contents of the backup file. This is how a whole installation moves to another server. Every user must sign in again afterwards.
settings.restoreConfirm: Really overwrite all data with this backup? This cannot be undone.
settings.usersUnlinkedHint: Accounts for administration, office and the warehouse screen. Employee accounts are managed on the respective employee page.
settings.privilegedHint: All accounts that are administrators or can see financial data (prices, revenue).
settings.deleteUserConfirm: Really delete this user account? The user will no longer be able to sign in. Audit entries are kept.
settings.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete the account you are currently signed in with. Sign out, sign in with another administrator account and delete this account from there.
settings.cannotDeleteLastAdmin: This is the only active administrator account. First create another administrator account (or give an existing account the Administrator role), then delete this one.
settings.auditHint: Who changed what and when — searchable and filterable.
settings.historyHint: A company arrives with years of finished work — imported cards, jobs long settled. Name the day from which BauCrew is kept: everything finished before it counts as old data. It stays fully visible and still counts in reporting, but it is no longer chased under data quality.
settings.historyEmptyHint: Leave empty: then every project is asked for a date and an order value, old ones included.
settings.apiKeysHint: Programs from outside — an automation, an AI assistant such as Claude — talk to BauCrew through a key. Every key acts as one office account: the same role, the same view of financial data. Whoever may not see prices does not get them through the interface either.
settings.newKeyHint: The key is shown exactly once. Afterwards only its beginning can be seen.
settings.keyUserHint: An office account (administrator or manager). Crew accounts get no key.
settings.keyScopeHint: "Feedback tasks only" is the key for a coding agent: it reads the feedback tasks with their screenshots and writes notes, proposals and the status (never "Done") — and reaches nothing else.
settings.keyCopyHint: Copy it now and store it safely — it will not be shown again.
settings.keyRevokeConfirm: Revoke key "{name}"? Programs using it will be locked out.
settings.connectHint: In the commands, KEY stands for the key. The address is this installation's.
settings.connectApiHint: JSON over HTTPS. Every route is described in docs/API.md.
settings.connectFeedbackHint: With a "Feedback tasks only" key (best for an account of its own, "agent"), once on the computer the agents run on. From then on every session works with the live list of this installation.
settings.connectClaudeDesktopHint: Claude Desktop reaches servers on the network through the mcp-remote bridge (needs Node.js).
settings.connectDocs: What the assistant can do: find and create projects and change their status, look up customers, employees and vehicles, read the schedule and plan assignments, read revenue by month and the plan match (with financial access only).
settings.webhooksHint: BauCrew tells an automation such as n8n what happens: a project is created, changes status, gets new dates, a new value or another site manager, or is deleted; or an invoice is ready; or somebody writes a comment. Every message is signed with the webhook's secret. If it does not arrive, BauCrew tries again after a minute, five, thirty, two hours, six and a day. The messages include prices — only administrators set up webhooks.
settings.boardsHint: The projects as a board — like Trello, but every column is a status: dragging a card into another column changes the status, and scheduling, reports and automations read the status as they always did. Several boards, so sales sees enquiries and offers and the site managers see the running sites, each on a board of its own. A project stands on every board that has a column for its status.
settings.boardOnlyOne: The last board stays; it cannot be deleted.
settings.webhookNewHint: In n8n, add a “Webhook” node with the method POST and enter its address here.
settings.webhookUrlHint: The n8n webhook's production URL, not the test URL.
settings.webhookErrorUrl: Please enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
settings.webhookRotateConfirm: The old secret stops working — n8n needs the new one.
settings.webhookDeleteConfirm: Delete webhook “{name}”? Messages not yet delivered are deleted with it.
settings.webhookDeliveriesHint: The last 40 messages. What did not arrive is retried automatically, or can be sent again here by hand.
settings.webhookAttempts: {count, plural, =0 {no attempt yet} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
settings.webhookHowHint: The signature is HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body with the webhook's secret. In n8n, switch on “Raw Body” in the Webhook node and compare in a Code node.
settings.webhookHowDocs: The other way round, n8n talks to BauCrew through the API — keys under
settings.weatherHint: Source: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) using the German Weather Service models (DWD ICON). For the next 14 days the day's highest rain probability and rain amount at the project's location are checked (exact when the place is recognised, otherwise by name). The next 7 days are a firm warning, days 8–14 only a trend. Recommended: 60–70 %. Affects dashboard, projects and scheduling; only work categories ticked as outdoor work.
settings.prepTabHint: The first tab of the project list combines several statuses (default "To prepare": lead + quoted + ordered). Name, included statuses and visibility can be set here.
settings.prepTabUnscheduledOnly: Only projects without any assignment in the schedule
settings.accentHint: Colour of buttons, active tabs and highlights — pick your corporate colour. Applies everywhere immediately.
settings.brandingHint: Name, colour and logo — shown in the app and on the work order.
settings.clientTypesHint: Choice on a project (e.g. private, commercial, public). Existing projects keep their value.
settings.buildingTypesHint: Choice on a project (e.g. new build, renovation, bridge, road).
settings.itemKindsHint: Kinds in the warehouse (e.g. tool, material, warning sign, barrier tape). "Tool" prints in the left column of the work order, everything else on the right.
settings.leadSourcesHint: Where requests come from (phone, e-mail, Instagram …) — picked on the project.
settings.roleHintSiteManager: Site manager: their own projects, the schedule and the overview — no prices, no master data or settings. The account must be linked to an employee.
settings.boardImageInvalidType: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
settings.boardImageTooLarge: The image is larger than 8 MB.

reports.title: Reporting
reports.cockpitHint: Everything here is derived from data already entered — none of it is recorded twice.
reports.cockpitStagesHint: Where the money stands — by the state of the projects, not by month.
reports.cockpitStuckHint: Either the work is done and nobody said so, or it has slipped and nobody wrote it down.
reports.cockpitDaysLate: {count, plural, one {# day over} other {# days over}}
reports.cockpitUnplannedHint: Open work that stands in no month — and sheet lines with no project.
reports.cockpitNothingUnplanned: Every open job has a date.
reports.cockpitSheetLines: {count, plural, one {# sheet line without a project} other {# sheet lines without a project}}
reports.cockpitGapsHint: What the figures are missing to be complete.
reports.gapWithoutPriceLabel: Open work without an order value
reports.gapWithoutStart: Open work without a planned start
reports.gapBilledWithoutPrice: Completed or invoiced, without a value
reports.cockpitSitesHint: What is running, and what starts in the next two weeks.
reports.introCompare: The year against other years – month by month, by quarter, year by year and as a running total. With a period chosen above, the year comparison and the cumulative table count only those months; the chart and the quarters show the whole year and highlight the period.
reports.introPlan: Planned revenue month by month from the projects – every job in the month it runs in (fixed start, else the expected month; over several months in shares) – no invoice amounts. Year and period above apply to every figure on this page; a click on a month shows the jobs in it, and a job can be dragged into another month.
reports.introUsage: Scheduled working days from the schedule (Mon–Fri, once a day, without absences) for the year and period above – counted from the first to the last day the schedule is written for. Public holidays count as working days.
reports.introGaps: As of today: what is missing or contradicts itself and so distorts a figure. A tile shows only its entries; click an entry to go where it is fixed. Jobs from the history before the cutoff are not checked.
reports.standHint: This tab shows today's state and does not follow year and period.
reports.listOffersUncounted: Open offers starting this month (not counted)
reports.usagePeopleHint: Days on the schedule (Mon–Fri, once a day) against the working days without absences, as far as the schedule is written. The ring above is the sum of this list.
reports.usageVehiclesHint: Days on the schedule (Mon–Fri, once a day) against the working days from the first to the last vehicle booking – vehicles without any booking included.
reports.gapValueOrDateHint: Without an order value the job counts in no total; without a month or a date it stands in no month of the planned revenue. Value from the offer on, month or date from planned on – enter it in the project.
reports.gapValueVsPlan: Order value does not match the year plan
reports.gapValueVsPlanHint: The year plan's lines add up to a different amount than price + change orders. Correct either the price on the project or the lines in plan matching.
reports.gapSubHint: Project and plan lines disagree about own crew or SUB – this distorts "of which SUB".
reports.gapLooseLinesHint: Year plan lines from the running month on that have no project yet (or whose project was cancelled). Create the project or assign it in plan matching.
reports.gapLooseLinesPast: {count, plural, one {# earlier line} other {# earlier lines}} of this year · {amount} – record only, not checked
reports.gapHistorical: {count, plural, one {# job from the history (before {date}) with gaps is} other {# jobs from the history (before {date}) with gaps are}} not checked – Settings → History.
reports.gapLooseLinesPastCount: {count, plural, one {# earlier line} other {# earlier lines}} of this year – record only, not checked
reports.situationHint: Each month by the state of the jobs behind its lines: finished, ordered or in progress, still an enquiry or offer, or a plan line without a project. The dot marks the same month last year, the dashed line an ordinary month. Click a month to see its jobs.
reports.listOffered: Lead or offer, not yet confirmed
reports.listSheet: Only in the sheet, no active project
reports.situationOfferAge: {count, plural, one {# day old} other {# days old}}
reports.situationNothing: Nothing is open in this month.
reports.noAccess: You do not have permission to view revenue reports.
reports.chartTitle: Planned revenue by month – {year} compared with {prev}
reports.chartCompareHint: The percentage next to a compared year says how far {year} lies above (▲) or below (▼) that year. The card “Planned revenue by year” below counts differently: there each year stands against the year before it.
reports.chartWholeMonth: For every year: point at the month name
reports.noRevenueInPeriod: No projects are planned in the selected period.
reports.customersHint: Contract values of projects planned in the period, per customer. Share of the period total.
reports.concentrationWarning: {name} accounts for {share} % of revenue in the period — high dependency on one customer.
reports.inactiveTitle: Customers without a project for over 12 months
reports.inactiveHint: An opportunity to call. Sorted by last project.
reports.noInactive: All customers had a project in the last 12 months.
reports.utilizationHint: Assignment days ÷ working days (Mon–Fri) in the period, up to today for a running period. Below 50 % and above 90 % are highlighted.
reports.qualityHint: These items distort revenue, utilization or weather warnings. Click an entry to fix it.
reports.qInProgressNoSchedule: In progress but no assignment in the next 14 days
reports.qFinishedNoPrice: Completed without contract value — missing from revenue
reports.qNoCity: Planned or under way but with no town — no weather warning
reports.qMissingItems: Items currently missing in several projects
reports.qCityNotFound: City cannot be located — no weather warning possible
reports.qStockShort: Stock lower than demand (open projects, not yet packed) — stock / demand
reports.offersHint: All projects with status "quoted", oldest first. Net amounts. Flagged after {days} days without an answer.
reports.qStaleOffers: Offers without an answer — worth chasing
reports.quarterHint: Each percentage compares the quarter with the same quarter of the year named beside it — Q1 against Q1, not against the year’s average. Clicking a row makes that quarter the period for the whole page; clicking it again takes it back. In the running year, later months are still planned figures.
reports.planWithoutMonth: Plus {amount} for sites not yet put on a month (pencilled in).
reports.undatedSummary: {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} without a planned start ·
reports.undatedHint: These projects have no planned start, so they belong to no month. They do not count towards the year total until a date is set.
reports.undatedHintSheet: These projects have no planned start and no line in the year plan. In a year with a year plan they count only once they are in the sheet or tied to a line in the plan match.
reports.undatedHistorical: {count, plural, one {# finished project from the old data is not listed here.} other {# finished projects from the old data are not listed here.}}
reports.planGapsAheadHint: Sites from the year plan for this month and the ones ahead that have no project yet. Earlier months are past and live on only in the plan match.
reports.planGapsPast: {count, plural, one {# plan line from earlier months} other {# plan lines from earlier months}} without a project — nothing left to do.
reports.qualityHistorical: {count, plural, one {# finished project from the old data is} other {# finished projects from the old data are}} not listed here (Settings → Old data).
reports.qNoPlannedStart: No date — counted in no month (planned, under way or done)
reports.hintOwnPeople: Order values of the projects running this month that the own crew carries out – with a fixed start in its month, else in the expected month; a job over several months counts a share in each. Plus lines of the planning sheet that have no project yet.
reports.hintSub: Order values of this month's projects carried out by a subcontractor – and the sheet's SUB lines without a project.
reports.hintPlan: The year plan's (sheet's) sum for this month. Next to it, projects minus plan: green once the plan is reached, amber below it. The difference usually comes from plan lines without a project — the line below says where from.
reports.chartClickHint: Click a month to list the jobs of every compared year underneath.
reports.monthJobs: {count, plural, =0 {no jobs} one {# job} other {# jobs}}
reports.monthEmpty: No job stands in this month.
reports.monthSheetLine: Line of the year plan with no project tied to it
reports.usageBarsHint: Share of booked person-days per month – amber below 50 %, green above 90 %. A month before the first or after the last day on the schedule stays empty.

trelloSync.title: Trello sync
trelloSync.intro: The server reads the boards of the Trello account the key belongs to and brings every board that is switched on into the projects by itself, hourly and on the button. Lists become the board's columns, the status follows the list's name, the customer is read off the card. Nothing to upload, nothing to map. While the office works in Trello, Trello is the source; on the day of the switch the boards are turned off here.
trelloSync.notConfigured: The server needs TRELLO_API_KEY and TRELLO_TOKEN (see DEPLOYMENT.md). Until then the import works from a file.
